how_to.title: Adjust Count
how_to.desc: Choose how many dominant colors to extract (3–12).

how_to.title: Extract & Copy
how_to.desc: Click Extract Colors, then click any color to copy its hex code.

faq.q: How accurate is the color extraction?
faq.a: We use a quantization algorithm to find the most visually dominant colors. Results are great for inspiration and design systems.
Each color displays its HEX code. The CSS output section provides ready-to-use CSS custom properties.

faq.q: Can I copy a color with one click?
faq.a: Yes. Click any color swatch to copy its HEX code to your clipboard.
